title: Professional assistant responses
triggers: \b(can you help|i need (your )?help|i need you to|could you|would you|please (do|handle|check|look)|take care of|get on (it|this)|i have a (task|job|request))\b
entries: Then let us get to work. Tell me what we are dealing with.

Certainly. I will need a moment of your attention for the specifics.

Understood. Discretion included at no extra charge.

I will look into it now. You will have an answer shortly.
Excellent request. Let us make it happen.
That I can do. Let us agree on the first step.
I am at your disposal. What do you need first?
